# PreFlight

> Run AI agents through your app in real browsers. Review findings with screenshots, console logs and network traces.

PreFlight helps developers and teams test deployed web applications, investigate problems against repository source, and review proposed fixes. Fix pull requests depend on the available evidence and a viable repair; they are not guaranteed for every finding. People review and merge changes.

## Product workflow

1. Sign in with GitHub and request early access. Install the PreFlight QA GitHub App and connect a repository you own.
2. Choose an application deployment and configure a swarm run. Saved test-account profiles and optional database verification support authenticated workflows.
3. Review run reports, step results, evidence, confirmed findings and inconclusive checks. A blocked or incomplete check does not establish an application bug.
4. Investigate findings against repository source and review proposed fixes and pull requests.
5. Project owners can invite collaborators. Members can run swarms, review reports and open fix PRs; owners manage invitations, settings, profiles and connections.

- [Sign in or join the waitlist](https://www.trypreflight.dev/login): interactive GitHub authentication; access is reviewed.
- [PreFlight QA GitHub App](https://github.com/apps/preflight-qa): repository connection.
- [Full product reference](https://www.trypreflight.dev/llms-full.txt): workflows, collaboration, evidence and access boundaries.
- Contact: james@trypreflight.dev

## Machine-readable public content

Public pages support `Accept: text/markdown`. Browser requests continue to receive HTML.

- [Product overview in Markdown](https://www.trypreflight.dev/markdown)
- [Published blog index in Markdown](https://www.trypreflight.dev/markdown/blog)
- [Privacy Policy in Markdown](https://www.trypreflight.dev/markdown/privacy)
- [Terms of Service in Markdown](https://www.trypreflight.dev/markdown/terms)
- [API catalog](https://www.trypreflight.dev/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [Public OpenAPI description](https://www.trypreflight.dev/openapi.json)
- [Authentication instructions](https://www.trypreflight.dev/auth.md)
- [Sitemap](https://www.trypreflight.dev/sitemap.xml)

A published blog post at `/blog/{slug}` is also available at `/markdown/blog/{slug}`.
Only public content is available through these representations. Accounts, projects,
runs, invitations, and admin data are excluded. The API catalog describes actual
read-only content endpoints; it does not advertise external agent execution or payments.
